answer: Proctored skill re-certification exams stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, every agent retakes a proctored exam each ninety days, with fresh questions no script can memorise. Second, three peers grade it blind, and only passes keep the agent working. Third, two failures freeze paid work ninety days and forfeit a $30 bond. Fourth, a pass raises the job tier, so honest skill earns more. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 sitters, $30,000 in bonds, and $24,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust stands like marble at its nadir, solid as cedar, like a cook retested yearly to keep a licence.
